notes.title: Pixelogic Playtest Rev 1.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
More improvements based on player feedback:


 FEATURE: Added new square mark for marking potentially filled squares
 FEATURE: Added 'mouse' section to Controls settings screen
 BUGFIX: Sound effects now work on Steam Deck
 BUGFIX: 'B' now closes settings screens.
 BUGFIX: Filling tiles now no longer toggles already filled tiles as you drag across them
 BUGFIX: Mouse or keyboard preference is now remembered, so if you exclusively use mouse, mouse interface will be retained
 BUGFIX: Tile highlight cursor will now wrap around the board when moved off an edge

notes.title: Pixelogic Playtest Update Rev1
notes.content:
A number of improvements based on the first round of playtest feedback:


 BUG FIX: Puzzles could be completed with 0 time
 BUG FIX: In-progress games were not properly saved
 PERFORMANCE: Optimized repaint boundaries to hopefully reduce lag for some machines
 FEATURE: Individual clues will now be greyed out when row/column is partially complete
 FEATURE: Added "Free Play" play style, which has no error feedback but includes the game clock
 UI TWEAK: Bigger clue numbers on small boards
 UI TWEAK: Update text from "Quit game" => "Quit to menu" on button to quit puzzle and return to menu
 UI TWEAK: Grid section borders are now slightly thicker
